reasons.plausibility: Interface-mediated dislocation pinning is a well-established strengthening mechanism in multilayer coatings, making the hypothesis scientifically sound.
reasons.testability: Comparing creep performance and dislocation structures of multilayer vs. monolithic coatings under identical conditions provides a clear, feasible test.
reasons.usefulness: It directly links interface design to time-dependent deformation resistance, offering a valuable experimental route for optimizing high-entropy alloy coatings.
